extraction: VizieR ASU TSV export, -out=**&-out.max=unlimited. Cleaned file maps upstream columns to a standard schema (id,ra_deg,dec_deg,z,z_err,q_flag,member_flag) and appends sep_arcmin and R_proj_Mpc computed from the cluster centre with FlatLambdaCDM(H0=70,Om0=0.3). No rows dropped. Where the upstream redshift is stored as a velocity cz in km/s it is converted to z=cz/c and its uncertainty is converted consistently to dz=e_cz/c; otherwise no values are altered. Raw upstream response kept verbatim in raw/.
note: MACS J0416.1-2403 (z=0.396). Balestra, Mercurio, Sartoris et al. 2016, ApJS 224, 33 ('CLASH-VLT: the Frontier Fields cluster MACS J0416.1-2403'), table 2. 4386 reliable redshifts. Quality: column q_z, 2-9 (CLASH-VLT convention as above); column r_z (1-5) is the reference code. Instrument: VLT/VIMOS (CLASH-VLT), plus MUSE and literature. Selection function: Subaru/Suprime-Cam Kron R-band photometry, R<24-ish, with colour-colour preselection (again NOT a clean magnitude-limited sample). Rmag spans 15.2-25.7. Sky coverage: to ~17.4 arcmin (~5.5 Mpc projected); 90% within ~4.3 Mpc. Largely subsumed by Caminha+2017 (4594 rows) - prefer that one, and de-duplicate if stacking.
